content.text:
Based on the latest run of the Zwolle load task:

**Model Actually Used:** `tft` (Temporal Fusion Transformer)

**Model Requested:** `auto` (which runs a validation tournament to automatically select the best model)

**Fallback Reason:** `nhits unavailable: no GPU worker`

The run requested an automatic tournament (model_id="auto"), but the N-HiTS model was unavailable because there was no GPU worker available at the time. The system fell back to using TFT instead. Despite this fallback, the run still completed successfully and showed a better performance than the baseline, with an MAE delta of -272.5 (a -4.7% improvement) on 672 scored rows.
